notes.title: Patch Notes – July 25: "Numbers Go Up" Edition
notes.notes:
[p][b]TL;DR:[/b]

 Player stats now shown in the between-round item menu
 Selecting an item/weapon shows how it affects your stats
 Most requested feature so far—now live!
 Under the hood: a ghost test-bear simulates the stat changes for preview

Hey everyone! Still plugging away here—it's been 11 days since launch, one hitbox-fixin’ patch later, and now I’ve got something new for all you min-maxing chaos enthusiasts:[/p][p][/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45559197/68b52d0361d2595baf78e7c3b3b742b186404fc9.png"][/img]
The [b]between-round item menu now shows your player stats[/b]—so you can finally answer life’s most important question: [i]“Wait… what even is my crit chance right now?”[/i]

Even better, when you [b]select an item or weapon[/b], the game now previews how it’ll affect your stats [i]before[/i] you buy it.
This has been, by far, the most requested change, and I totally get it—guessing how a 12% Attack Speed boost interacts with your current build was not exactly ideal.

Now, you can make smarter decisions, regret different things, and blame the chicken instead of the UI.

[b]Dev nerd corner:[/b]
To make this work, Bearzerk now secretly spins up a little invisible test-bear in the background—a phantom player that temporarily equips the item so we can simulate your new stats exactly as they’d be applied.
It’s like a ghost version of you doing science. For murder.
More updates and new content are brewing in the background—thanks again for all your feedback, bug reports, and chaos.

As always, come yell at me (or whisper gently) on [url="https://discord.gg/cntPYGz25G"]Discord[/url] or [url="https://www.reddit.com/r/bearzerk"]Reddit[/url].

– Your secretly-running-a-shadow-bear solo dev[/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes – July 25: “Whiff This” Edition
notes.notes:
TL;DR:

[list]
[*] Hitboxes tightened for both mobs and players
[*] Collisions should now feel more fair and intuitive
[*] New audio cue when taking damage
[/list]

Hey everyone! Quick update today focused on something many of you pointed out (and I very much agreed with):

[b]Hitboxes were chonky.
[/b]Like, "why did I take damage from that dude’s toenail grazing my scalp" kind of chonky.

This patch tightens up hitboxes across the board—player and mobs alike—so collisions should now feel a lot more fair and readable. Specifically, I’ve adjusted the collision shapes to better match the visible sprite bounds, especially vertically.

In 2D games like Bearzerk, everything collides in screen space, not depth. So when the bottom of an enemy overlaps the top of your head, it’s technically a “hit,” even if it visually feels like you were on different planes. That’s what was happening before. It felt off. It was off. That’s fixed now.

[b]Also added:[/b]
– New audio feedback when you take damage, to make hits feel more impactful (and hopefully help you avoid eating five in a row by accident).

Thanks again to everyone giving feedback on hitboxes—it really helps make the game feel better. As always, if something still feels weird, yell at me on Discord or Reddit and I’ll keep tweaking.

More weirdness coming soon.

– Your probably-not-colliding-with-your-shoes-anymore solo dev

notes.title: Patch notes 05.24.2025
notes.notes:
Hey Bearzerkers!

Quick update on the demo—here's what's improved:

Better Weapon Balance: Weapon rarity and duplicate limits adjusted for fairer demo gameplay.


Clearer Buy Menu: Updated interface provides better clarity when selecting new weapons for purchase.

Accurate Weapon Tracking: Weapon instances now tracked directly, the shop is now accurately tracking and considering current weapons equippied when math'ing about prices for your new weapon purchases.

Fistfull of pills: Fistfull of pills is fun - fun enough to not just be a 1-round thing. It now persists throughout a run. Think twice!

Jump back in and let us know what you think!

Stay chaotic,
Your friendly neighborhood solo dev

notes.title: Beta Key Giveaway Update
